crossRefs.note: Greet Tryphaena and Tryphosa, who labor in the Lord. Greet Persis, the beloved, who labored much in the Lord.
Many women were there watching from afar, who had followed Jesus from Galilee, serving him.

people.name: Mary
people.line: A woman who worked hard for the church in Rome.

translations.web: Greet Mary, who labored much for us.
translations.bsb: Greet Mary, who has worked very hard for you.
translations.kjv: Greet Mary, who bestowed much labour on us.
translations.asv: Salute Mary, who bestowed much labor on you.
